packageRules.description: Never automerge major updates — always open a PR for human review
Hold TypeScript below 7 until @astrojs/check (peer ^5 || ^6) and typescript-eslint (peer <6.1.0) support it; TS 7 fails build, check, lint, knip and unit tests (PR #1414, 2026-09-30)

Hold prettier-plugin-astro below 1: v1 reformats .astro templates in a way that adds whitespace to rendered text (e.g. 'Tilaa ' inside buttons), breaking 30 render tests and needing a site-wide visual review (PR #1455, 2026-09-30)
One PR for all non-major updates — main is protected with strict mode and 15 required checks, so a per-package PR invalidates every other open PR the moment one merges, and the queue stalls
Automerge non-major updates once required CI checks pass
